description: This file defines a plugin entry for the Qwen provider in an OpenClaw plugin system. It imports provider SDK functions, build functions for various media providers, configuration application functions, and sets up API keys and provider metadata. It exports a default plugin entry that registers media understanding and video generation providers.

methods.name: applyQwenStandardConfigCn
methods.description: Applies Qwen standard configuration for China endpoint.

methods.description: Applies Qwen configuration for global/intl endpoint.

methods.description: Applies Qwen configuration for China coding endpoint.
